## What changed and why

Describe the single feature, fix, or maintenance task. Include before/after behavior
and reproduction steps for a bug fix. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

- Commands and results:
- Android/MuMu observations, device and game version (if applicable):
- Not tested or known limitations:

Add screenshots or a short recording for visible UI changes; remove private information.

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR contains one focused change, with no unrelated cleanup or formatting.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added/updated and checks run, or the reason they are not applicable is explained.
- [ ] A concise Unreleased changelog entry was added for user-facing app changes, or is not applicable.
- [ ] README and affected usage/website guides were updated, or the reason no update is needed is explained.
- [ ] Generated bindings were regenerated when applicable; compatibility limitations are documented.
- [ ] The diff contains no game packages/assets, signing keys, private logs, account details, or generated build outputs.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jpitty03/PGRazor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for requirements. Release publishing is handled by maintainers.
